source.title: How Stake Became a $2.6 Billion Casino Without a Single Building
source.note: English profile of Stake that cites the Casino Secrets documents reported by Follow the Money. Summaries paraphrase what the video says; they are claims, not findings of this project.

mentions.claim: Stake.com was launched in June 2017 by Ed Craven and Bijan Tehrani with a Curaçao licence and an office in Melbourne.

According to the leaked documents, Stake's new licence was issued conditionally; the regulator gave the company five weeks to explain its relationship with the founders, and the paperwork names a different man as sole owner.
mentions.note: The video does not name the company or the declared owner; both are added from the register (Stake's licensee and its recorded ultimate beneficial owner).
